page_title: BAR 1-0 MAL | Barcelona v Mallorca 22/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Miguel Ortiz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Some neat passing and movement from Barcelona as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Mallorca earn a corner.
87' The referee signals a corner kick to Barcelona.
86' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Lamine Yamal is replaced by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona).
86' Here is a change. Omar Mascarell is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Jan Salas (Mallorca).
86' Here comes a substitution. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Cyle Larin.
86' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Barcelona.
85' A snap shot by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) from the edge of the area flies towards the top right corner, but Leo Roman produces a good reflex save to thwart him.
84' Raphinha (Barcelona) will take a corner kick.
84' Pau Victor (Barcelona) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Leo Roman has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
82' Gavi (Barcelona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Mallorca win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
81' Johan Mojica comes off the pitch to be replaced by Toni Lato (Mallorca).
81' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Valery (Mallorca) replaces Antonio Sanchez.

79' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Leo Roman shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
77' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pau Victor (Barcelona) replacing Ferran Torres.
77' It will be a substitution. Gerard Martin (Barcelona) is ready to enter the pitch as Hector Fort walks off.
76' Barcelona get a corner.
74' Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
71' Hector Fort (Barcelona) brings an opponent down and Miguel Ortiz interrupts the game.

70' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
69' Corner kick. Mallorca will have an opportunity.
67' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is penalised for holding. Miguel Ortiz signals a set piece. Barcelona are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
66' A substitution has been made. Samu Costa goes off and Marc Domenech (Mallorca) comes on.
64' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
62' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Dani Olmo and he is replaced by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
62' Here comes a substitution. Ansu Fati is given a rest as he is replaced by Raphinha (Barcelona).
60' The ball is behind the touchline and Mallorca will take a throw-in.
58' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 27:1.

55' What an opportunity! Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the resulting free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
54' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) makes a strong challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Mallorca.
53' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
52' Miguel Ortiz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Gavi (Barcelona).
50' Ansu Fati (Barcelona) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Leo Roman.
49' The attendance is 45602.
46' 1 - 0 Dani Olmo (Barcelona) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
46' The whistle blows and Miguel Ortiz starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Now Barcelona have a corner.
45' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
44' Ansu Fati (Barcelona) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
41' Barcelona have a corner.
41' Hector Fort (Barcelona) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
38' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
36' A clumsy foul by Gavi (Barcelona) and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle. Mallorca earn a free kick.
35' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well over the bar.
34' The resulting set piece from Barcelona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

31' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early low towards the middle of the goal, but Leo Roman pulls off a great save to deny him.
30' Great chance! Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies a whisker wide of the right post.
30' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
29' A terrific attempt by Gavi (Barcelona) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post.
27' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
26' Great save! Dani Olmo (Barcelona) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Leo Roman.
25' Miguel Ortiz shows the yellow card to Samu Costa (Mallorca) for a heavy challenge.
24' Ansu Fati (Barcelona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Miguel Ortiz who sees an offensive foul. A free kick has been awarded to Mallorca.
23' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Dani Olmo (Barcelona).
21' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Ansu Fati (Barcelona) offside.
20' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) will take the corner.
19' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Wojciech Szczesny comes off the line to clear the ball away.
18' The ball is out of play. Mallorca will take a throw-in.
17' The percentage of ball possession is – 81:19.
14' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Mallorca have a free kick.

12' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Leo Roman pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom right corner.

12' A sweet pass finds Ferran Torres (Barcelona) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Leo Roman is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
11' Barcelona keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
9' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.

7' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
6' The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
5' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
4' The ball has crossed the sideline. Mallorca are taking a throw-in.
2' The cross into the penalty area from Ansu Fati (Barcelona) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
